summary: Extends IKEv2 so that more than one key exchange can contribute to the shared secret during security association setup, using the IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange and a new IKE_FOLLOWUP_KE exchange for rekeying. It is aimed at hybrid and post-quantum key exchange.

eli5.summary: To make a secret lock safer, two people mix several secret recipes together, so it stays safe even if one recipe gets cracked later.

questions: how to do post-quantum key exchange in ikev2
